equipment, including Total Stations, GNSS receivers, laser scanners, imaging equipment, GPS systems, and data collectors.- Validate survey measurements using GNSS, Total Station, and laser scanning technologies.- Prepare and manage setting out data for upload to survey instruments.- Process and analyse survey data using software such as AutoCAD, StarNet, and Leica Cyclone.- Carry out regular calibration checks and maintenance of survey equipment and accessories.- Undertake additional project and surveying-related tasks as required.What You Will Bring- Completed vocational training, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field.- Experience in construction surveying, engineering surveying, setting out, or as-built surveying would be advantageous.- Previous experience working on construction sites within the building construction, industrial construction, or infrastructure sectors is desirable.- Understanding of surveying principles, methodologies, and geospatial data collection techniques.- Experience working with modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations and GNSS systems.- Experience with laser scanning technologies and related software (e.g. Leica Cyclone) would be beneficial.- Eligibility to work in Germany.- Good communication skills in English; German language skills would be advantageous.- Highly motivated, quality-focused, responsible, and able to work effectively as part of a team.Benefits You Will LoveAt Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. We recruit, train, and promote without regard to protected characteristics. For more information, see our EEO resources. Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com (https://mailto:MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com)  Agency Notice Please do not contact any employee of Woolpert or its subsidiaries about this requisition.
